thread:
Alex: quick check — I'm rolling out a small Terraform change to switch our k8s secret sync to the new secret-bridge service (instead of ExternalSecrets controller). PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/789. Main change is adding secretbridge SA + k8s permissions. Can someone eyeball the SA permissions? I'm worried about token rotation behaviour.
Priya: looking now. Is this the change that removes the ExternalSecrets CRD and writes k8s Secrets directly? :thinking:
Alex: yes, secret-bridge pulls from Vault then writes Secret objects; it uses a long-lived SA with bounded KMS scope. We moved to short-lived tokens using projected service account tokens — see tf snippet:
```
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "secret_bridge" {
  metadata { name = "secret-bridge-sa" namespace = "infra" }
}
resource "kubernetes_cluster_role_binding" "sb_bind" {
  role_ref { kind = "ClusterRole" name = "secret-bridge-writer" }
  subject { kind = "ServiceAccount" name = kubernetes_service_account.secret_bridge.metadata[0].name namespace = "infra" }
}
```
Priya: projected tokens should auto-refresh, but rotation depends on the bridge supporting token refresh. Does bridge use TokenRequest API? :eyes:
Sam: it does in my local branch — uses TokenRequest every 30m. But Vault lease rotation was flaky in staging last night; I saw 503s when rotation overlapped with write windows.
Maria: do we have backoff/retry? bridge retries with exponential backoff 5 attempts. It also keeps a small local cache per secret to avoid thundering herd.
Alex: pinging @Priya and @Sam — if we require TokenRequest we need the RBAC for serviceaccounts/token create. I added clusterrole rule but might be missing the resource path and apiGroup.
Priya: rule should be: { apiGroups: [""], resources: ["serviceaccounts/token"], verbs: ["create"] } — confirm in PR.
Sam: adding that now. Also we should annotate k8s Secrets with 'redwood/rev: <lease_id>' so we can track which Vault lease created it.
Maria: agree. Also add ownerReferences? maybe not — secretbridge rotates in-place.
Alex: sample k8s secret manifest produced by bridge:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: prod/db-credentials
  namespace: payments
  annotations:
    redwood.com/rotation: "daily"
    redwood.com/vault-lease: "s:abcd1234"
data:
  username: <base64>
  password: <base64>
```
Priya: that annotation key looks fine. For rotation cadence, daily is ok for creds but ensure Vault TTL aligns. Who will monitor rotation failures? ops oncall?
Sam: I'll add a grafana panel for 'secret-bridge: rotation failures' and an alert if >5 in 5m.
Alex: thanks. One final ask — are we comfortable with removing ExternalSecrets CRD in the same deploy? Might be safer to keep a compatibility mode for 1 week.
Maria: prefer compatibility mode. How about feature-flag 'bridge.alpha.remap-externalsecrets: true' toggled in kustomize.
Priya: SGTM. I'll add RBAC fix and the tokenrule, Sam add alert, Maria add flag, Alex update PR description. :thumbsup:
extsecrets-bot: deploy pipeline started for infra/secret-bridge PR#789 — smoke tests queued.
Alex: cool, thanks everyone. I'll wait for the RBAC patch and then merge canary.
